facts.fact: INAH’s bulletin dated 25 January 2025 groups the Basilica, Sagrario, former educational/religious institutions and Plaza Don Vasco in the historic cultural area, linking the city’s architecture to education, care, religion and cultural confluence.

facts.fact: The bulletin explains that the colonial religious/political centre was built on a Purépecha ceremonial precinct. This supports historical layers and connections among the stops, without equating all buildings or claiming an unchanged visitor route.
facts.location: Historical-context paragraph beginning Muestra de ello

facts.fact: This is a 2025 nomination announcement, not evidence of the outcome of a UNESCO evaluation in 2026; the guide makes no World Heritage inscription claim.
facts.location: Paragraph describing submission of the nomination
